items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 13 at 1:51AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
Thursday into the weekend, a series of low pressure systems will
move toward Southeast Alaska, bringing widespread moderate to heavy
rainfall and gale force winds to the Gulf. Strong winds are also
expected for coastal and southern panhandle communities. While the
exact timing and impacts of the system are still being refined,
confidence is continuing to increase that this will be a more
impactful system for Southeast Alaska.

Stay tuned to weather.gov/juneau as we continue to monitor the

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 13 at 1:07AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
As temperatures drop below freezing, any wet spots that lingered
through the day have begun to freeze creating some slick spots.
Use extra caution during the morning commute or if you are out
walking around as you may come across some icy spots.

items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 12 at 8:33PM AKDT until October 13 at 11:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility down to 1/4 mile in dense fog.

* WHERE...Petersburg Borough.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make travel conditions hazardous.
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued October 12 at 10:07AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:

heavy rain across much of the Panhandle into the weekend. However,
areas south of Frederick Sound will likely see the heaviest rain.
